messages:
sara: Quick preflight — final check for v1.12.0. Need sign-offs on version bump, changelog, QA gate, security scan, and an explicit rollback plan. Target cutoff is ~24h from now. Any blockers?

dan: I can own the version bump and tag. Will open the bump branch in ~2h and add the changelog entry.

anya: Docs: I'll run changelog lint and add a short migration note for the tokenization tweak. Planning to link PR to release doc.

leo: QA — scheduling a quick canary smoke tomorrow morning. Can you confirm the exact deploy window so I can book regression reviewers?

jen: Owning rollback. Drafted a minimal rollback runbook — putting it in the release doc now. Quick steps: 
```
# rollback steps
git checkout -b hotfix/v1.12.0-rollback origin/main
git revert <PR_TO_RELEASE>
./scripts/deploy --env=staging --dry-run
# if checks pass
./scripts/deploy --env=prod --tag=v1.12.0-rollback
```
Also added required post-rollback verification checks.

mike: Security scan: running Snyk now. Quick heads up — there's a transitive dep flagged, will update ticket if it needs a suppression.

security-bot: SNYK: 1 medium issue detected in org/depX (transitive). Suggested mitigation: upgrade to depX@4.2.0. Ticket #SEC-431 created.

sara: Two asks: (1) paste the rollback steps into the release doc (link) and (2) add a one-line regression probe to the smoke script: `curl -sfS https://canary.internal/health?verbose=1 | jq .kv_cache` — we want kv cache metrics visible during canary.

dan: Done — opened release/v1.12.0-bump -> PR #5820, adding the release artifact build step to PR body. @anya @leo please review changelog and QA checklist.

anya: LGTM on the changelog content. Small nit: move the migration note under "Breaking changes" section. I'll push that edit.

leo: QA schedule: quick canary at 10:30 PT (5% surge, 15m observation), full smoke at 11:00 PT if canary is green. I'll have regression reviewers on standby.

jen: Rollback runbook added to the release doc: https://internal.redwood/release/v1.12.0.md — includes exact commands and who to call for DB rollbacks.

mike: Security ticket #SEC-431 created and assigned to infra-team; ETA EOD for the dependency bump. Will comment on the PR when merged.

sara: Setting cutoff: 24h from now at 15:00 UTC. If we have all thumbs (docs, qa, security, version bump) by then we proceed to canary. If rollback plan isn't validated by QA, we hold the release.

dan: Building release artifact locally now. Command added to PR: 
```
./scripts/build-release --version v1.12.0 --artifacts
```
I'll attach binaries to the PR.

anya: docs-lint run: `make docs-lint` -> no errors. Link to docs commit in PR.

leo: QA note: please ensure the canary is limited to 5% traffic and that the surge controller has the following flags: `--max-inflight=50 --observation-window=15m`. That avoids cascading load.

sara: Final ask before cutoff: @mike can you confirm the SSO and auth smoke passes by EOD? Security needs that check to be green.

mike: Confirmed, I'll add a comment on PR and attach the auth smoke logs.

sara: Thanks team — I'll post final go/no-go at cutoff. :rocket:
